text:
Asha (growth): quick flag 10am PST webinar landing shows a spike in signups but paid spend doesn't match. can someone check the KPI dashboard?
Ben (analytics): looking at Launch > Webinar KPI > last 48h. link: https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/webinar-kpi?range=48h
Ben (analytics): signups +280 during 01:00-02:00 UTC, paid clicks only +15. conversion from organic low quality (higher bounce). feels like misattributed paid traffic.
Iris (ops): checking click logs for that window. click export shows 920 clicks; 36 have utm_campaign missing, many UA = Android webview.
Diego (ads): we did a small APAC boost at 00:50 UTC using short-loop creative. campaign param = apac_march_launch, should be present.
MetricsBot: pipeline note: ingest-2026-03-27T01:25Z processed; 29 anomalous rows identified with missing utm_campaign in partition 2026-03-27-01.
Asha (growth): ok that explains the channel mix. operational asks: 1) annotate dashboard for Friday KPI review; 2) flag affected leads in the weekly KPI sheet; 3) pause nurture for those IDs until reclassification.
Ben (analytics): will add dashboard annotation and compute pre/post CAC impact. quick estimate: if 36 leads reclass to paid, CAC for this launch cohort shifts by ~9%. will show numbers on slide 3.
Iris (ops): creating ticket MKT-6120 "webview strips utm_campaign on redirect" and assigning to eng-redirects. quick mitigation: append campaign server-side on first redirect. infra ETA ~4h.
Diego (ads): can we also add a temporary tag on ad landing that sets campaign via server JS if missing? low risk quick fix for mobile clients.
Iris (ops): noted. will coordinate with infra and tag the ticket. rejoin job queued after infra patch: reproc-3789-01.
Asha (growth): please add a one-line note in the KPI doc: "03/27 APAC attribution drift due to webview param loss; reclassification pending reproc."
Ben (analytics): sample reproc will be posted when ready. also will add pre/post conversion and CAC deltas for Friday review.
Diego (ads): follow-up: double-check paid dashboard to ensure spend attribution won't double-count after reproc.
Iris (ops): will add a QA step in the rejoin to prevent duplicates. tagging CRM IDs with "hold-reclass" until job completes.
Asha (growth): thanks team. next: Ben  pre/post numbers for Friday; Iris  infra ticket + hold flags; Diego  quick client-side tag explore. Ill call out in Friday KPI sync. :white_check_mark:
